question: Does arm GG (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 on keithtyser's pinned vLLM stack, driving OUR q38-undo agent tree) go into the 2026-09-03 00:00Z daily slot INSTEAD of D-undo?
why_this_file_exists: docs/PLAN_TOP3.md schedules GG's first board draw for 09-06 to 09-08, after a Kaggle bench on 09-05. CLAUDE.md rule 15(d) forbids an ungated structural change in a scored slot because a scored run returns one number and nothing else, so a failure is unattributable forever. gate-predeclared-2026-09-02-arm-GG-flashnext.json lists 'spending a scored slot on GG before a completed Kaggle commit exists' under WHAT_IS_NOT_ALLOWED. The owner has asked whether the missing GPU gate can be replaced by offline evidence strong enough to justify going five days early. This file fixes the conditions BEFORE the evidence is gathered, because this project has twice picked its metric after seeing the numbers and both times it pointed toward promoting something.

FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.note: Listed so no reader mistakes these for conditions this gate tests. They are inputs, established by command output, and they are the reason the gate below is written the way it is.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.kaggle_gpu_quota: EXHAUSTED. `kaggle kernels push` of a trivial GPU probe kernel returned 'Kernel push error: Maximum weekly GPU quota of 30.00 hours reached.' The refusal happens at push time and cost zero quota. Next reset 2026-09-05.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.gcp_gpu_quota: UNAVAILABLE. Project <gcp-project-id> is authenticated (<work-profile-email>) but GPUS_ALL_REGIONS limit is 1.0 and no NVIDIA_RTX_PRO_6000 / G4 metric exists in us-central1, us-east4, us-west1 or europe-west4; PREEMPTIBLE_CPUS limit is 0.0 in all four, so Spot cannot start at all. The quota requests filed 2026-08-29 have not been granted.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.consequence: There is NO GPU available to this session anywhere. Every mechanism condition in gate-predeclared-2026-09-02-arm-GG-flashnext.json (model loaded, PLE offload live, KV pool, watchdog restarts, decisions and actions, tool-call parse rate) is UNMEASURABLE today. GG cannot be gated on behaviour, only on construction.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.falsifier_F1_read_early: keithtyser is rank 93 of 2,708, score 2.36, 71 submissions, last submission 2026-09-01T05:00:52Z (leaderboard/download, read 2026-09-02T07:0xZ). His Flash-Next run finished 05:00:01Z on 09-01 and he submitted 51 seconds later. His board best is unchanged 22+ hours on, and it is BELOW our banked 3.15. So the single hidden-set datum for Flash-Next is non-positive. This does not refute the model (his harness scores 25 levels on the public 25 where ours scores 35) but it removes the only evidence that the +11 public-level gain transfers to the board.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.sources_resolve: datasets/view returns keithtyser/duck-qwen38-nvfp4-mtp-vllm-smoke-v1 (v10, 61,517,270 bytes, public) and keithtyser/qwen38-flash-next-vllm-nvfp4-runtime-v1 (v1, 7,906,699,712 bytes, public); models/get returns keithtyser/qwen3-8-flash-next-nvfp4 instance radixark-modelopt-fp4 (public, RadixArk @7b719225...); kernels/pull returns the notebook, version 14, 53 votes, machineShape NvidiaRtxPro6000, enableInternet false.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.notebook_structure_seen: 18 cells, the same TAAF Duck lineage as our own submission.ipynb. The agent tree is NOT in the notebook: cell 7 locates the source bundle by the marker file taaf-kaggle-bundle.json and cell 9 executes that bundle's setup_commands.json. So GG is a DATASET merge (our q38 tree + his serving assets), and the notebook change is a DATASET_SOURCES re-point.
FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED_BEFORE_WRITING_TH.NOT_yet_read_at_writing_time: serving_setup.py, serving_teardown.py, vllm_server_watchdog.py, vllm-patches/, his setup_commands.json, and any integrity check they contain. Those are the crux and this gate is genuinely undetermined on conditions O3 and O5 below.

DEFAULT_IF_ANY_CONDITION_FAILS_OR_CANNOT: D-undo ships in the 2026-09-03 slot. GG is left fully built and staged for the 2026-09-05 Kaggle bench under the arm-GG gate. 'Cannot be evaluated' counts as a FAIL, not as a pass, because the whole point of the override is that offline evidence must REPLACE the missing run, not be excused by it.

PATH_A_the_normal_gate.condition: A completed Kaggle 25-game commit of GG exists and passes the seven mechanism conditions of gate-predeclared-2026-09-02-arm-GG-flashnext.json, or a GCP session booted the stack and completed at least one full act-and-observe cycle on at least one game.
PATH_A_the_normal_gate.status_at_writing: IMPOSSIBLE TODAY, see FACTS_ALREADY_VERIFIED. Recorded so the file is still correct if quota appears.

PATH_B_the_offline_override.rule: ALL SEVEN of O1..O7 must pass. Any single failure ships D-undo. No condition may be reworded, dropped, or traded off against another after the evidence exists.
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O1_every_reference_resolves: The two datasets, the model instance, the competition source and OUR new GG dataset each return HTTP 200 from datasets/view, models/get or the competition endpoint, at the exact version the kernel-metadata.json pins.
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O2_notebook_is_byte_derived: GG's submission.ipynb is produced by editing keithtyser's version-14 notebook, which is known to have booted this exact stack on this exact machine shape. The diff may change ONLY string-literal values (dataset refs, kernel id, title) and environment-variable VALUES. It may not add, remove or reorder a single Python statement, and it may not touch cells 5, 9, 11 or 15. Measured by a structural diff, reported as changed-statement count, which must be 0. Rationale: CLAUDE.md rule 15(b2), where a hand-built notebook failed on every slug and every version with a wheelhouse error at In[2].
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O3_serving_setup_accepts_a_foreign_bundl: serving_setup.py must run unmodified, or every modification must be a named-constant re-point whose new value is verified to exist. HARD FAIL IF: it verifies a hash, manifest or identity of the bundle DIRECTORY it lives in, or of the agent tree beside it, in a way our merged bundle cannot satisfy without a run. Verifying the MODEL checkpoint, the RUNTIME layers or its own PLE patch is fine, because those are unchanged. This is unresolved item 6 of docs/PLAN_TOP3.md section 9 and it is the condition most likely to fail.
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O4_worst_case_KV_fits: admitted concurrency (vLLM --max-num-seqs) x --max-model-len must be <= 2.5 x the measured GPU KV cache pool in tokens, AND the analyzer context window must be <= --max-model-len minus the generation headroom the tree reserves. The 2.5x bound is not invented: keithtyser's measured working point is 8 x 32,768 = 262,144 against a 105,202-token pool = 2.49x, and it produced 36 levels, 659 decisions and 3,695 actions. GG may not be MORE oversubscribed than the configuration that is measured to work. Note this fails outright if our 49,152 analyzer window is carried over (8 x 49,152 = 3.74x).
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O5_our_tree_and_his_parser_agree: The tool-call parser and chat template his launcher passes (--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser qwen3 --chat-template <model>/chat_template.jinja) must accept the tool schema and message shape OUR q38 tree emits, verified by reading both sides. HARD FAIL IF our tree emits a schema, a tool name, or a chat-template kwarg (e.g. preserve_thinking, reasoning_effort) that his launcher does not configure. Rationale: arm CC3 reasoned lucidly for 21 to 27 turns per game and called submit_actions ZERO times across 25 transcripts. A tree that cannot get its actions parsed scores 0 while looking healthy in every other log.
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O6_the_tree_still_builds: python3 solution/kaggle/overlay/apply_overlay.py --self-check passes, every .py in the merged bundle compiles under python3 -m compileall, and the merged bundle's manifest hashes recompute.
PATH_B_the_offline_override.O7_offline_suite_passes: The solution/sim/ checks that do not need a GPU pass, including test_submit_pick_tonight.sh, and the merged bundle passes solution/kaggle/deploy_candidates.py preflight.

EXPLICITLY_NOT_ALLOWED: Shipping GG on the strength of the public-25 level counts alone. Those are keithtyser's harness, not ours, and the transfer to the hidden set is exactly what F1 fails to support.

Shipping GG because a draw is cheap. The cost of an ungated scored draw is not the 0.05 board points; it is that a 0.00 is unattributable across at least five candidate causes (serving_setup rejection, PLE OOM under the gateway sidecar, tool-call parse failure, KV starvation, notebook error) and therefore teaches nothing, which is the entire reason rule 15(d) exists.
Relaxing O3 or O5 to 'probably fine' after reading the code. Both are pass/fail on whether a specific verification or mismatch EXISTS, not on how likely it is to matter.
Treating 'no GPU was available' as a reason to lower the bar. It is a reason the bar cannot be cleared today.
Pinning LOCAL_ANALYZER_SEED on whatever ships (standing rule until 2026-09-30).
WHAT_A_PASS_WOULD_MEAN: GG would be, in substance, keithtyser's booting notebook plus a dataset that swaps one agent tree for another of the same lineage, with the serving stack, model, runtime and profile untouched and every changed value verified to exist. That is a materially smaller change than 'an ungated structural change', and at a 3.15 floor the board keeps our maximum, so it would be worth the draw.
WHAT_A_FAIL_MEANS: D-undo ships, which is not a loss: it is the config that drew our best-ever 3.15 and has only one draw, so it is also the draw that carries the most information about our own best mean. GG then goes to the 09-05 bench with its own predeclared gate intact and its first board draw stays attributable.
